response.overview: About a Father that hit the lottery while trying to get full custody of his Son. One day after having a day of hanging out, a group of Gangstaz saw the opportunity to take what he had won and followed him to the car planning to rob him. He being a former boxer never backed down from a fight wasn't giving in easy. Hè bucked and they shot him but didn't know his 8 year old son was with him. When they saw him and knew he could point them out they had to finish what they started killing the son too. When he awakened from being in a coma and realized they took his only son. All hell broke loose.
response.title: Death Struck
